correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Nash-stability iff statement with self-inclusive FHG u_v(C)=|N(v)∩C|/|C|. Splitting a petal leaves one endpoint with utility zero and a profitable mate-coalition deviation. Hub cannot be singleton. For hub s complete petals, an outside block t petals causes hub profitable entry iff t>s; outside endpoint entering hub would improve only if t>s+1, and every other move gains no neighbor, so cutoff t≤s is necessary and sufficient including ties. Counting labeled s subsets and restricted set partitions gives N_m and joint N_m(s,ell), welfare =6s/(2s+1)+ell. Unrestricted welfare max m+1 uniquely up to m hub-triangle choices, stable; unique worst Nash is grand coalition welfare 6m/(2m+1); PoS1, PoA exact. Independent enumeration of every set partition on 2m+1 vertices for m=1..4 recovered counts 1,3,7,21, all Nash/profitability tests, and welfare maxima/minima. These finite tests corroborate unrestricted proof, do not extend m by induction.
